heading: I-797C Notice of Action
page_text_first_1200: Jump to content An official website of the United States government Here's how you know My Account Resources Sign Out Skip to main content I-131, Application for Travel Documents, Parole Documents Getting Started Client Information Upload PDF Evidence 2" x 2" Photo of you Photo Identity Document I-797 Notice of Action I-797C Notice of Action Additional Evidence Review & Submit I-797C Notice of Action Provide a copy of your current Form I-797C notice that was issued to communicate any of the following applicable actions: receipt or rejection of an application or petition; transfer of file(s); biometric appointment, interview appointment, rescheduled interview appointment, reopening of case(s); or additional USCIS action. File upload requirements Clear and readable. Accepted file formats: JPEG, JPG, PDF, TIF or TIFF No encrypted or password-protected files. If your documents are in a foreign language, upload a full English translation and the translator's certification with each original document. Upload no more than 5 documents at a time.
